title: IPMA, weather warnings open data (warnings_www.json)
what_it_says: IPMA's open data for weather warnings by area; area LSB is the Lisbon district. Read at 16:32 UTC on 10 November 2026, after the article's 14:23 and 14:34 readings: the Lisbon warnings were unchanged. Read again at 18:32 UTC: the rain warning for Wednesday had become red from 12:00 to 18:00 (orange before that).
